input_fields.name: execution_event
input_fields.description: Unique run ID, launch time, script hash, and session/document binding.

input_fields.name: status_observation_source
input_fields.description: Allowed UI/log/report source and observation timestamps.

input_fields.name: timeout_policy
input_fields.description: Bounded wait, polling interval, and unknown-state rule.

result_fields.name: terminal_state
result_fields.description: Completed, failed, or unknown state with event evidence and run ID.

procedure: Bind observations to the supplied run ID and script/session identity.
Poll the declared source until completed, failed, or timeout; record meaningful transitions.
Return completed/failed only with a terminal event; return unknown with last observation and reason.
Never press Run again during the wait, including after a transient UI stall.
rejection_rules: Reject missing/duplicate run ID, missing timeout policy, or an unbound observation source.
Reject timeout as success; unknown remains unknown.
Do not save or inspect geometry while waiting.
